ski: Rain falls at 7 of 8 Washington resorts today. Snow returns to the Washington Cascades Friday, and Saturday stays dry.
hike: Rain and light mountain snow cross the Washington Cascades today, with Thursday drier. Driest Thursday is at Hoh & Quinault, with no rain, a high of 41 and gusts to 11 mph; models split on cloud versus clear, NWAC has no rating posted.
